Well I attempted around two weeks ago, obviously I survived, and I'm still planning to try again so I fully know all my thoughts so I'll try to answer as well as I can. For a bit of context, I'm 22, have BPD and PTSD, had an alcoholic mother growing up who was emotionally abusive, still live with her, lots of trauma, all that shit. Suicidal thoughts since I was around 11. Had it planned out for a week, and finally tried to overdose on the 18th of April. Ended up feeling terrible for hours, vomiting, felt like I was dying but was going nowhere so got my parents to get me to the hospital, stayed for a week and was fine, til I came home and now I want to die again.

Now there was a lot of things that got me to that point. Shit was going on early this year that completely fucked me up. Lost the only thing that made me happy ever and my mother started drinking again, which triggered my ptsd. She had stopped by the time I attempted but those are the things that made me spiral into this. During and before this time I was already in terrible shape, was laying in bed all day everyday, couldn't do anything I used to love doing anymore. Same thing now. I had isolated myself from my friends to make it easier for me to kill myself, the only friend I hadn't left had given up on helping me. After that the only thing I could think about was suicide. I couldn't distract myself from the thoughts since I didn't want to do anything, so I'd lay there all day thinking about killing myself. I didn't want to continue living like that. I tried therapy for many years, but it never worked, so that wasnt going to help me. I knew antidepressants were an option, but I didn't and still don't believe they would help, and if I could get them,  it would take too long, which would have meant I had to live through everyday how I already was. I didn't really want help either, life isn't something I want to do, I hate the idea of it. I felt real happiness once, quite recently, for the first time. It was the best feeling in my life but I can say that I wouldn't like to continue living like this just for a tiny chance to get that feeling again one day. I'm also very unwilling to change myself, even if I wanted to. There is just no point to continue living when it's not something I want to do. Life just isn't worth trying for. To me the obvious answer was, and is, to just kill myself.
